occupation: regular employee of the Government of Sikkim
other_conditions: Applicant must be a regular employee in service of the Government of Sikkim.
Dependent family members (spouse, siblings, children (including adopted), parents of self or spouse) are eligible up to a maximum of five dependents.
benefits_summary: Provides cashless hospitalization with up to ₹10 lakh cover per family per year, including critical care, ambulance, maternity and other medical expenses.
